_comment: EZ Good Finds — Content Factory config. Copy to config.json and edit. Unknown keys are ignored.

brand.name: EZ Good Finds
brand._logo: OFFICIAL logo PNG with alpha. Never let AI redraw it. Near-white pixels = the power/house glyph (stays white); everything else is recoloured to the artwork's dominant colour.

llm._comment: provider: ollama (free, local — recommended) | openai (any OpenAI-compatible server) | none (templates only)
llm._vision: optional Ollama vision model (e.g. minicpm-v:8b) that reads feedback screenshots for you

comfyui._comment: mode: auto (use ComfyUI when reachable) | comfy | fallback. Export YOUR workflow with Save (API Format) to workflowPath, then set promptNodeId/promptField (the text node) and baseImageNodeId (the LoadImage node that receives the deterministic base layout; empty if your graph needs none).

postiz._comment: Self-hosted: http://YOUR-HOST/public/v1 — Cloud: https://api.postiz.com/public/v1. channels empty = post to ALL connected integrations.

publish._comment: dry-run = write payloads to outbox only (DEFAULT — review a week of output first). live = really schedule on Postiz.
